FlowerPainter.Feature.volleyball.Tooltip: A 16 × 8 m sand volleyball court with a net, run-off sand and benches for spectators.
FlowerPainter.Feature.basketball.Tooltip: An asphalt basketball half-court with a hoop facing the path, optionally fenced and floodlit.
FlowerPainter.Feature.tableTennis.Toolti: Outdoor ping-pong tables on a paved pad, with benches at the ends.
FlowerPainter.Feature.chess.Tooltip: Chess tables on paving under a shelter or shade trees, optionally with a giant board.
FlowerPainter.Feature.fitness.Tooltip: Outdoor gym equipment on a soft surface: a cluster, a calisthenics row or a ring.
FlowerPainter.Feature.splashPad.Tooltip: A round paved pad with water jets for children, ringed by benches for the parents.
FlowerPainter.Feature.bandstand.Tooltip: A bandstand at the end of a lawn with arcs of benches, or a gazebo in a ring of flowerbeds.
FlowerPainter.Feature.dogRun.Tooltip: A fenced dog run with a gate towards the path, agility items, benches and dog bins.
FlowerPainter.Feature.noticeboard.Toolti: A community noticeboard or park map with a bench, a bin and a lamp, by default near an entrance.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Volleyball.Name: Volleyball pit
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Volleyball.lines.Too: Marking decals at the court's base lines (when marking decals are installed).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Volleyball.Issue.Sma: The volleyball court was made smaller than 16 × 8 m to fit.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Basketball.Name: Basketball court
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Basketball.court.Too: A half-court with one hoop (15 × 14 m) or a full court with two (28 × 15 m, needs a long space).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Basketball.lines.Too: Marking decals at the key and the centre circle (when marking decals are installed).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Basketball.fence.Too: A fence round the court with one gate towards the path.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Basketball.Issue.Hal: A full court does not fit here; a half-court was built.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TableTennis.Name: Table tennis
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TableTennis.shade.To: One shade tree off a corner, away from the play space.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Chess.Name: Outdoor chess
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Chess.giant.Tooltip: A 5 × 5 m board laid in the paving with benches for the players.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Chess.shade.Tooltip: A shelter over the tables when one is installed, otherwise two shade trees.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Fitness.Name: Fitness stations
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Fitness.layout.Toolt: An outdoor gym cluster, a calisthenics row along one side, or a ring of stations facing outwards.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Fitness.surface.Tool: A rubber, bark or gravel surface under the equipment.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SplashPad.Name: Splash pad
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SplashPad.shade.Tool: Two shade trees on the side away from the path.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Bandstand.Name: Bandstand
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Bandstand.kind.Toolt: A bandstand plays to a lawn of benches; a gazebo sits in the middle of a ring of flowerbeds.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Bandstand.rows.Toolt: Arcs of benches facing the bandstand (all round a gazebo).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Bandstand.flowers.To: A ring of flowerbeds round the structure, open towards the audience.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DogRun.Name: Dog run
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DogRun.agility.Toolt: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles spread over the run.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DogRun.smallDogs.Too: A fenced-off third of the run for small dogs.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DogRun.amenities.Too: Dog bins and drinking posts by the gate.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Noticeboard.Name: Noticeboard
